purpose: Independent TABULA window/renovation-measure expectations and explicit preservation guards for the bounded residential quick corrections. Benchmark values are transcribed from the retained workbook, not generated from catalogue values.

sources.selection: Swedish national SFH/MFH SE.01–SE.05 variants; all three zone variants use the same selected window U, glazing g and frame fraction. Exact zone benchmark locators remain in tabula_u_values.json.

window.selection_scope: Representative original-period TABULA stock assumptions and prescribed standard replacement measures; no product geometry, historic manufacturing recipe or aged measurement is inferred.
window.optical_scope: Whole-aperture SHGC = glazing g * (1 - frame fraction); whole-aperture VT applies the same glazing fraction. VT is an explicit EPSM default, not a TABULA measurement. Opaque-frame transmission/gain, angular factors and external shading are excluded.
window.baseline_carbon_scope: Boverket 6000000104 remains a labelled approximate modern timber triple-glazed carbon-family proxy; it is not an exact historic window match.

unchanged.scope: The 57 other stored archetype/state window assignments, excluding the separately reviewed SF SE.01 original and SF SE.01–SE.05 advanced windows. Accepted-definition guards are not external acceptance benchmarks; carbon metadata is reviewed separately.

office_se05.year_basis: Accepted original representative construction year; renovation states preserve this year rather than replacing it with a renovation date or a rounded era year.
office_se05.construction_set_revision_basis: Intermediate-floor source order normalized once to canonical bottom-to-top; all material properties, thickness, nominal U, total mass/capacity and original construction year retained.

baseline_snapshot_scope: Preservation guards retain each selected original thermal-top/wall definition. SF SE.01 and SF SE.02 top cases use their independently source-reviewed original ceilings in cases/sf_se01.json and cases/sf_se02.json; other original snapshots remain unchanged. These are not external TABULA benchmarks; expected renovated U is calculated forward from fixed original inputs and prescribed additions.
